title-tag: Carpet in a Basement: When It Works in the PNW
meta-description: Basement carpet works in the PNW when the slab is proven dry — a free 24-hour plastic test decides it. The all-synthetic spec, and when vinyl wins instead.
post-summary: October 8, 2026 · Carpet works in a Pacific Northwest basement on one condition: the slab is proven dry, not assumed dry — a free 24-hour plastic-sheet test decides it. The all-synthetic spec that survives below grade, room-by-room verdicts, and the situations where we honestly point you at vinyl plank instead.
